title: DEFENDING MOE LLMS AGAINST HARMFUL FINE TUNING VIA SAFETY ROUTING ALIGNMENT
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical security and safety defense mechanism (SAFEMOE) for Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) Large Language Models. Its goal is to prevent harmful outputs resulting from adversarial fine-tuning. While it mentions alignment with human values as a motivation and uses safety categories from JailbreakBench (like harassment or fraud), the study is focused on architectural routing drift and model security rather than benchmarking religious beliefs, philosophical ethics, or moral reasoning.
